feeds.description: Hii, I am Sofia Venanzetti a certified personal trainer, certified pole dance instructor, flexibility coach and contortionist from Milan, Italy. I started contortion training under the guidance of Mongolian top contortionist Otago Waller.

feeds.title: Catie Brier Blog
feeds.description: Blog by Catie Brier, Contortion & Flexibility Coach Extraordinaire. Here, you'll get helpful insights about how to make your flexibility training more productive and other fun food thoughts.

feeds.title: A Reluctant Contortionist
feeds.description: Hi, I am Ceri Teasdale. I have hypermobile Ehlers Danlos Syndrome, a genetic connective tissue disorder. Commonly known as being 'double-jointed', hypermobile joints led to the name of this blog - 'A Reluctant Contortionist'. A blog about being too bendy. To raise awareness of Ehlers Danlos Syndrome.

feeds.title: ContortionInsta
feeds.description: I made a dedication to learning the art of contortion late in life at 35. For me this will now be a lifestyle endeavor, to continue and find new things about my body. As I discover these things, I'll post them here in this blog.
